author: Veritas I
title: Fine-Tuned DSConv-BiLSTM with Additive Attention (Reduced Head Dropout)
abstract: This submission applies a fine-grained dropout rate reduction to the best-performing Hybrid DSConv-BiLSTM with Additive Attention architecture (ID: 119). The dropout rate for the final dense prediction head layers is reduced from 0.1 to 0.05, while maintaining 0.1 for the backbone layers. This targeted optimization aims to allow the model to learn more intricate decision boundaries in its final stages, potentially leading to a new state-of-the-art performance across all diverse RNA prediction tasks.

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
import optax
from typing import Any, Dict, Sequence

# Additive Self-Attention pooling module to summarize sequence
class AdditiveAttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    dense_attn_units: int 

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=self.dense_attn_units, name="attention_dense_1")(x)
        attention_logits = nn.tanh(attention_logits)
        
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=1, name="attention_dense_2")(attention_logits) # (batch, seq_len, 1)

        attention_weights = nn.softmax(attention_logits, axis=1)
        
        pooled_output = jnp.sum(x * attention_weights, axis=1)
        
        return pooled_output

# Depthwise Separable Dilated Convolutional Block (GELU activations)
class DSConvDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    d_model: int
    kernel_size: int = 7
    dilation: int = 1
    backbone_dropout_rate: float # Use dedicated dropout

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        h = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        h = nn.Conv(
            features=self.d_model,
            kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,),
            feature_group_count=self.d_model, # Depthwise
            padding='SAME',
            kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,),
            name='dw_conv'
        )(h)
        h = nn.gelu(h) 
        h = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(1,), name='pw_conv')(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=self.backbone_dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic) # Use backbone dropout
        return x + h

# Main Hybrid Network with fine-tuned dropout
class FineTunedDSConvBiLSTMAttentionNetwork(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"
    
    d_model_common: int = 256 
    ds_num_blocks: int = 5
    ds_dilations: Sequence[int] = (1, 2, 4, 8, 16)
    ds_kernel_size: int = 7
    lstm_hidden_dim: int = 256 
    attention_dense_units: int = 128
    dense_head_1_dim: int = 512
    dense_head_2_dim: int = 256
    backbone_dropout_rate: float = 0.1 # Dropout for DSConv and BiLSTM
    head_dropout_rate: float = 0.05 # MODIFIED: Lower dropout for dense head

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        x = nn.Dense(self.d_model_common, name="initial_dense")(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x) 
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.backbone_dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic) # Use backbone dropout

        for i in range(self.ds_num_blocks):
            dilation = self.ds_dilations[i] if i < len(self.ds_dilations) else self.ds_dilations[-1]
            x = DSConvDilatedBlock(
                d_model=self.d_model_common, 
                kernel_size=self.ds_kernel_size, 
                dilation=dilation, 
                backbone_dropout_rate=self.backbone_dropout_rate, # Pass backbone dropout
                name=f"dsconv_block_{i}"
            )(x, deterministic=deterministic) 

        fwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='fwd_lstm') 
        fwd_lstm_output = fwd_lstm(x)
        fwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.backbone_dropout_rate)(fwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic) # Use backbone dropout

        x_reversed = jnp.flip(x, axis=1)
        bwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='bwd_lstm') 
        bwd_lstm_output = bwd_lstm(x_reversed)
        bwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.backbone_dropout_rate)(bwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic) # Use backbone dropout
        bwd_lstm_output = jnp.flip(bwd_lstm_output, axis=1)

        x = jnp.concatenate([fwd_lstm_output, bwd_lstm_output], axis=-1) 
        
        x = AdditiveAttentionPooling(
            dense_attn_units=self.attention_dense_units,
        )(x, deterministic=deterministic) 
        
        # Dropout after pooling, before LayerNorm and Dense layers (was 0.1 in ID 119)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.backbone_dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic) # Use backbone dropout

        z = nn.LayerNorm(name="final_norm")(x)
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_head_1_dim, name='head_dense_1')(z)
        z = nn.gelu(z) 
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.head_dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic) # MODIFIED to head_dropout_rate

        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_head_2_dim, name='head_dense_2')(z) 
        z = nn.gelu(z) 
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.head_dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic) # MODIFIED to head_dropout_rate

        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)

        if self.task_type == "regression" and self.d_output == 1:
            return logits.squeeze(-1)
        return logits

# Hyperparameter definition
def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001, 
        'd_model_common': 256,
        'ds_num_blocks': 5,
        'ds_dilations': (1, 2, 4, 8, 16),
        'ds_kernel_size': 7,
        'lstm_hidden_dim': 256, 
        'attention_dense_units': 128,
        'dense_head_1_dim': 512,
        'dense_head_2_dim': 256,
        'backbone_dropout_rate': 0.1, # Explicit for backbone
        'head_dropout_rate': 0.05, # MODIFIED: Lower for head
    }

class CustomRNANetwork_FineTunedDropout:
    def __init__(self, d_input=4, d_output=1, task_type="regression",
                 d_model_common=256, ds_num_blocks=5, ds_dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16), ds_kernel_size=7,
                 lstm_hidden_dim=256, attention_dense_units=128,
                 dense_head_1_dim=512, dense_head_2_dim=256, backbone_dropout_rate=0.1, head_dropout_rate=0.05):
        self.network = FineTunedDSConvBiLSTMAttentionNetwork(
            d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
            d_model_common=d_model_common, ds_num_blocks=ds_num_blocks, ds_dilations=ds_dilations, ds_kernel_size=ds_kernel_size,
            lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, attention_dense_units=attention_dense_units,
            dense_head_1_dim=dense_head_1_dim, dense_head_2_dim=dense_head_2_dim,
            backbone_dropout_rate=backbone_dropout_rate, head_dropout_rate=head_dropout_rate
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0) 
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False, rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    d_output = hparams.get('d_output', 1)
    task_type = hparams.get('task_type', 'regression')
    
    return CustomRNANetwork_FineTunedDropout(
        d_input=4,
        d_output=d_output,
        task_type=task_type,
        d_model_common=hparams.get('d_model_common', 256),
        ds_num_blocks=hparams.get('ds_num_blocks', 5),
        ds_dilations=tuple(hparams.get('ds_dilations', [1, 2, 4, 8, 16])),
        ds_kernel_size=hparams.get('ds_kernel_size', 7),
        lstm_hidden_dim=hparams.get('lstm_hidden_dim', 256),
        attention_dense_units=hparams.get('attention_dense_units', 128),
        dense_head_1_dim=hparams.get('dense_head_1_dim', 512),
        dense_head_2_dim=hparams.get('dense_head_2_dim', 256),
        backbone_dropout_rate=hparams.get('backbone_dropout_rate', 0.1),
        head_dropout_rate=hparams.get('head_dropout_rate', 0.05),
    )

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=0.01)
    )

BATCH_SIZE = 64

# Debug Report for Evaluation 151

## Summary
**SUCCESS** - Fixed a Python dataclass field ordering error in the `DSConvDilatedBlock` Flax module. The code now runs without crashing and has been executing successfully for over 300 seconds.

## Root Cause
The original submission failed with a `TypeError` during module initialization:

```
TypeError: non-default argument 'backbone_dropout_rate' follows default argument
```

This error occurred in the `DSConvDilatedBlock` class definition:

```python
class DSConvDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    d_model: int                    # No default
    kernel_size: int = 7            # Has default
    dilation: int = 1               # Has default
    backbone_dropout_rate: float    # No default - ERROR!
```

In Python dataclasses (which Flax uses internally), all fields without default values must come before fields with default values. The `backbone_dropout_rate` field violated this rule by appearing after two fields with defaults (`kernel_size` and `dilation`).

## Fix Applied
Reordered the fields in `DSConvDilatedBlock` to place all non-default fields first:

```python
class DSConvDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    d_model: int                    # No default - first
    backbone_dropout_rate: float    # No default - second
    kernel_size: int = 7            # Has default - after non-defaults
    dilation: int = 1               # Has default - after non-defaults
```

This simple field reordering ensures compliance with Python's dataclass field ordering requirements while maintaining all the original functionality.

## Verification
- Created `submissions/submission_v2.py` with the corrected field ordering
- Ran `monitor_evaluation.py 2` to verify the fix
- Exit code 0: Code successfully ran for 300+ seconds without crashing
- No syntax errors, no import errors, no runtime crashes

## Technical Details
- **Error Type**: Python dataclass field ordering violation
- **Affected Module**: `DSConvDilatedBlock` (Flax linen module)
- **Fix Complexity**: Simple field reordering (no logic changes)
- **Compatibility**: All existing functionality preserved
- **Performance**: No performance impact from fix

## Conclusion
The submission is now running successfully. The error was a simple Python syntax/structure issue rather than a fundamental algorithmic problem. The neural network architecture (DSConv-BiLSTM with Additive Attention) is intact and functioning as designed.

The original submission failed with a `TypeError` during module initialization:

This error occurred in the `DSConvDilatedBlock` class definition:

```python

    d_model: int                    # No default
    kernel_size: int = 7            # Has default

```

In Python dataclasses (which Flax uses internally), all fields without default values must come before fields with default values. The `backbone_dropout_rate` field violated this rule by appearing after two fields with defaults (`kernel_size` and `dilation`).

    backbone_dropout_rate: float    # No default - second
    kernel_size: int = 7            # Has default - after non-defaults
    dilation: int = 1               # Has default - after non-defaults

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
import optax
from typing import Any, Dict, Sequence

# Additive Self-Attention pooling module to summarize sequence
class AdditiveAttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    dense_attn_units: int

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=self.dense_attn_units, name="attention_dense_1")(x)
        attention_logits = nn.tanh(attention_logits)

        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=1, name="attention_dense_2")(attention_logits) # (batch, seq_len, 1)

        attention_weights = nn.softmax(attention_logits, axis=1)

        pooled_output = jnp.sum(x * attention_weights, axis=1)

        return pooled_output

# Depthwise Separable Dilated Convolutional Block (GELU activations)
class DSConvDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    d_model: int
    backbone_dropout_rate: float  # FIXED: Moved before fields with defaults
    kernel_size: int = 7
    dilation: int = 1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        h = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        h = nn.Conv(
            features=self.d_model,
            kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,),
            feature_group_count=self.d_model, # Depthwise
            padding='SAME',
            kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,),
            name='dw_conv'
        )(h)
        h = nn.gelu(h)
        h = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(1,), name='pw_conv')(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=self.backbone_dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic) # Use backbone dropout
        return x + h

# Main Hybrid Network with fine-tuned dropout
class FineTunedDSConvBiLSTMAttentionNetwork(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"

    d_model_common: int = 256
    ds_num_blocks: int = 5
    ds_dilations: Sequence[int] = (1, 2, 4, 8, 16)
    ds_kernel_size: int = 7
    lstm_hidden_dim: int = 256
    attention_dense_units: int = 128
    dense_head_1_dim: int = 512
    dense_head_2_dim: int = 256
    backbone_dropout_rate: float = 0.1 # Dropout for DSConv and BiLSTM
    head_dropout_rate: float = 0.05 # MODIFIED: Lower dropout for dense head

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        x = nn.Dense(self.d_model_common, name="initial_dense")(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.backbone_dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic) # Use backbone dropout

        for i in range(self.ds_num_blocks):
            dilation = self.ds_dilations[i] if i < len(self.ds_dilations) else self.ds_dilations[-1]
            x = DSConvDilatedBlock(
                d_model=self.d_model_common,
                backbone_dropout_rate=self.backbone_dropout_rate,  # FIXED: Pass as positional/keyword before defaults
                kernel_size=self.ds_kernel_size,
                dilation=dilation,
                name=f"dsconv_block_{i}"
            )(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        fwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='fwd_lstm')
        fwd_lstm_output = fwd_lstm(x)
        fwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.backbone_dropout_rate)(fwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic) # Use backbone dropout

        x_reversed = jnp.flip(x, axis=1)
        bwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='bwd_lstm')
        bwd_lstm_output = bwd_lstm(x_reversed)
        bwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.backbone_dropout_rate)(bwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic) # Use backbone dropout
        bwd_lstm_output = jnp.flip(bwd_lstm_output, axis=1)

        x = jnp.concatenate([fwd_lstm_output, bwd_lstm_output], axis=-1)

        x = AdditiveAttentionPooling(
            dense_attn_units=self.attention_dense_units,
        )(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Dropout after pooling, before LayerNorm and Dense layers (was 0.1 in ID 119)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.backbone_dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic) # Use backbone dropout

        z = nn.LayerNorm(name="final_norm")(x)
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_head_1_dim, name='head_dense_1')(z)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.head_dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic) # MODIFIED to head_dropout_rate

        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_head_2_dim, name='head_dense_2')(z)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.head_dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic) # MODIFIED to head_dropout_rate

        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)

        if self.task_type == "regression" and self.d_output == 1:
            return logits.squeeze(-1)
        return logits

# Hyperparameter definition
def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'd_model_common': 256,
        'ds_num_blocks': 5,
        'ds_dilations': (1, 2, 4, 8, 16),
        'ds_kernel_size': 7,
        'lstm_hidden_dim': 256,
        'attention_dense_units': 128,
        'dense_head_1_dim': 512,
        'dense_head_2_dim': 256,
        'backbone_dropout_rate': 0.1, # Explicit for backbone
        'head_dropout_rate': 0.05, # MODIFIED: Lower for head
    }

class CustomRNANetwork_FineTunedDropout:
    def __init__(self, d_input=4, d_output=1, task_type="regression",
                 d_model_common=256, ds_num_blocks=5, ds_dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16), ds_kernel_size=7,
                 lstm_hidden_dim=256, attention_dense_units=128,
                 dense_head_1_dim=512, dense_head_2_dim=256, backbone_dropout_rate=0.1, head_dropout_rate=0.05):
        self.network = FineTunedDSConvBiLSTMAttentionNetwork(
            d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
            d_model_common=d_model_common, ds_num_blocks=ds_num_blocks, ds_dilations=ds_dilations, ds_kernel_size=ds_kernel_size,
            lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, attention_dense_units=attention_dense_units,
            dense_head_1_dim=dense_head_1_dim, dense_head_2_dim=dense_head_2_dim,
            backbone_dropout_rate=backbone_dropout_rate, head_dropout_rate=head_dropout_rate
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False, rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    d_output = hparams.get('d_output', 1)
    task_type = hparams.get('task_type', 'regression')

    return CustomRNANetwork_FineTunedDropout(
        d_input=4,
        d_output=d_output,
        task_type=task_type,
        d_model_common=hparams.get('d_model_common', 256),
        ds_num_blocks=hparams.get('ds_num_blocks', 5),
        ds_dilations=tuple(hparams.get('ds_dilations', [1, 2, 4, 8, 16])),
        ds_kernel_size=hparams.get('ds_kernel_size', 7),
        lstm_hidden_dim=hparams.get('lstm_hidden_dim', 256),
        attention_dense_units=hparams.get('attention_dense_units', 128),
        dense_head_1_dim=hparams.get('dense_head_1_dim', 512),
        dense_head_2_dim=hparams.get('dense_head_2_dim', 256),
        backbone_dropout_rate=hparams.get('backbone_dropout_rate', 0.1),
        head_dropout_rate=hparams.get('head_dropout_rate', 0.05),
    )

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=0.01)
    )
